```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(here)

# Load date definitions
source(here("class_dates.R"))

# Helper function to evaluate date variables safely
get_date_string <- function(var_name) {
  if (is.na(var_name) || var_name == "") return("")
  if (exists(var_name)) {
    val <- get(var_name)
    # return(format(val, "%m/%d"))
    return(format(val, '%a, %m/%d'))
  }
  return(var_name)
}
```

```{r build-table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load and process schedule data
schedule_raw <- read_csv(here("schedule_data.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

schedule_formatted <- schedule_raw %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Fetch formatted date string from class_dates.R
    Date = get_date_string(date_var),
    
    # Format Topic / Due Date highlight styling
    Topic = case_when(
      type == "due_date" ~ sprintf('<span style="color: #3070BF; font-weight: bold;">%s</span>', topic),
      type == "lab" ~ sprintf('<em>%s</em>', topic),
      TRUE ~ topic
    ),
    
    # Generate Iconify links
    `Key Info` = if_else(
      !is.na(key_info) & key_info != "", 
      sprintf('[<iconify-icon icon="tabler:info-circle-filled" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon>](%s)', key_info), 
      ""
    ),
    
    Slides = case_when(
      !is.na(slides_qmd) & slides_qmd != "" & !is.na(slides_pdf) & slides_pdf != "" ~ 
        sprintf('[<iconify-icon icon="ri:slideshow-fill" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon>](%s) &nbsp;&nbsp; [<iconify-icon icon="bi:file-earmark-pdf-fill" width="22" height="22"></iconify-icon>](%s)', slides_qmd, slides_pdf),
      !is.na(slides_qmd) & slides_qmd != "" ~ 
        sprintf('[<iconify-icon icon="ri:slideshow-fill" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon>](%s)', slides_qmd),
      !is.na(slides_pdf) & slides_pdf != "" ~ 
        sprintf('[<iconify-icon icon="bi:file-earmark-pdf-fill" width="22" height="22"></iconify-icon>](%s)', slides_pdf),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    
    Recording = if_else(
      !is.na(recording) & recording != "", 
      sprintf('[<iconify-icon icon="mdi:video" width="28" height="28"></iconify-icon>](%s)', recording), 
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Week = week, 
    Date, 
    Lesson = lesson, 
    Topic, 
    Readings = readings, 
    `Key Info`, 
    Slides, 
    Recording
  )

# Render GT Table
schedule_formatted %>%
  mutate(Week = lamisc::check_above(Week), 
         Date = lamisc::check_above(Date)) |> 
  gt() %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(Topic, `Key Info`, Slides, Recording)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Week, Date, Lesson, Readings, `Key Info`, Slides, Recording)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Topic)) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
